operations.details: Verified official OGC Observations, Measurements, and Samples standard page.
Observation schema separated from physical sensor calibration and accuracy.
Sample or feature-of-interest identity not promoted to exact HMLR parcel geometry.
Observation result still requires datum, method and uncertainty provenance.
Verified official OGC JSON-FG standard page.
Additional CRS support separated from coordinate precision.
Richer geometry types not promoted to exact legal-boundary evidence.
Temporal encoding does not itself prove source survey recency or validity.
OMS and JSON-FG URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No observation schema or geometry extension substituted for numeric parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
